column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3678): the sqlserver subtest runs a scoped read as a login in cleat_app_role, which exists only on SQL Server, and gets its database from testutil.TestDB, which skips when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset. test-go/commands runs cmd/cleat-worker with only the PostgreSQL DSN, so that subtest skips there: 1 skip, measured 2026-11-10 by running it with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set and reading the skip name. The postgres subtest runs there as cleat_app and passes; it skips only where CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES is unset, and no job that sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL runs cmd/cleat-worker (multi-db-ci.yml runs ./engine/... and ./migration/... there).
